# katapult_disk_io_profiles (Data Source)

Lists disk I/O profiles available to the provider organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List the disk I/O profiles available to the provider organization.
data "katapult_disk_io_profiles" "available" {}

output "disk_io_profiles" {
  value = {
    for profile in data.katapult_disk_io_profiles.available.profiles :
    profile.permalink => {
      speed_in_mb = profile.speed_in_mb
      iops        = profile.iops
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `profiles` (Attributes List) Disk I/O profiles ordered lexically by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--profiles))

<a id="nestedatt--profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `profiles`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the disk I/O profile.
- `iops` (Number) The maximum I/O operations per second, or null when unlimited.
- `name` (String) The name of the disk I/O profile.
- `permalink` (String) The permalink of the disk I/O profile.
- `speed_in_mb` (Number) The maximum throughput in MB/s, or null when unlimited.
